description: This file defines a React functional component called SchedulePublic which renders a weekly schedule view for a gym management web application. It imports React, custom Card and SectionHeader components, and utilizes data from 'demoContent'. The component displays schedule data in a grid layout with a section header, schedule items, and a note about read-only access.

methods.name: SchedulePublic()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the weekly schedule page, displaying schedule data with associated UI components.
